name: Surfshark
author: nenadjokic
description: Surfshark VPN in the Omarchy bar: on/off, fastest, nearest, same country, a pinned US exit, a random country, recents and a search across every location. Drives the official client's own daemon, so the app and the bar never disagree.

barWidget.description: Toggle Surfshark, jump to the fastest, nearest, local, US or a random location, reconnect to recents, or search all locations.
